title: Mokuʻula restoration master plan
summary: The Mokuʻula restoration is part of the long-term recovery plan, with a master plan in development until June 2027 and a first step of removing tennis courts, a basketball court and a parking lot. The department is working with the Salvation Army to acquire land, and the commission took no action in August 2026.

timeline.text: A commissioner said they were very supportive of the project.
The presenter said this commission's 2019 recommendations will be built into the master plan.
The department is working with the Salvation Army to acquire land it still owns in the area.
Archaeological and cultural monitors will be part of all restoration work.
The first step would remove two tennis courts, a basketball court and a parking lot.
